html:
SMTO-SKL-0003 — This Skill's settings are too large to save

GUID: a13746bd-6067-41b6-a2a5-f991f4db6470
Slug: skill-configuration-too-large
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: skl

What happened

  • The settings for this one Skill add up to more than SMTO can store (about 64 KB of text). Your change wasn't saved, and the settings already in use are unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the Skill's settings window, select Remove on entries you don't use, such as search providers that are switched off. Every entry adds to the total size, and unused ones are the easiest to cut.
  2. Shorten any very long text you typed, such as long names or web addresses. Long text takes up most of the space in a Skill's settings.
  3. Select Save again. SMTO checks the size each time you save, so a smaller version is accepted.

What success looks like

  • The settings window says "Saved. Future calls use this configuration."

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete other Skills' settings, conversations or Parameter Store entries to make room; this limit applies to this Skill's settings on their own.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Skill configuration, as submitted or after canonicalization, exceeds the 64 KiB (65,536-byte) JSON-encoded limit, so it was rejected without being saved.

What this means

  • Serialized incoming or canonicalized Skill configuration exceeds 64 KiB. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Serialized incoming or canonicalized Skill configuration exceeds 64 KiB.

How to diagnose it

  • Measure serialized bytes rather than counting visible characters alone.

How to fix it

  • Both the request body (bounded_json in src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/skill_configuration.py) and the canonicalized result (SkillConfigurationDefinition.validate) must be at most 65,536 bytes when JSON-encoded. Remove unused entries (for Web, disabled search providers; at most 16 are allowed) or shorten long names and URLs, then save again; do not delete other saved data to work around the limit.
  • Reduce the configuration to its required fields and keep it within 64 KiB before saving.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Both original and canonical configuration fit the 64 KiB bound.

What not to do

  • Do not erase authoritative receipts or protected current input to conceal a size/capacity problem.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
